title: Get Process Working End to End
description: Get process working end to end. Plugin build fails in process/plugin/rs/lib.rs around toggle_sun_round_trips_through_runtime_and_defaults_off (corrupted WindowMeasure match arm). Fix compile errors and verify process 3d app runs via framework OS playground (dev:process:3d).
summary: Fixed process plugin compile failure and verified process 3d end-to-end. Root cause: corrupted match arm in toggle_sun_round_trips_through_runtime_and_defaults_off (stray WindowMeasure field lines pasted into a match). Restored WindowMeasure::Group match. cargo build wasm32-wasip2 release ok; cargo test -p process-plugin --lib 34/34 passed; React playground (SEMIO_RENDERER=react) serves on :6022; Playwright e2e shows Process 3D chrome with Timber Beam Joinery, one canvas, no render/page errors.
